import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    static final int INF_ = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;

    static class Edge {
        int v, r; long f, c, p;
        Edge(int v, int r, long f, long c, long p) {
            this.v = v; this.r = r; this.f = f; this.c = c; this.p = p;
        }
    }

    static class Flow {
        static final int N = 50*T + 2;
        static List<Edge>[] adj;
        static int[] sz;
        static long mc;

        static void init(int n) {
            mc = 0;
            adj = new ArrayList[n];
            for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            sz = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(sz, 0);
        }

        static void addEdge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            mc = Math.max(mc, c);
            adj[a].add(new Edge(b, sz[b]++, 0, c, p));
            adj[b].add(new Edge(a, sz[a]++, 0, 0, -p));
        }

        static boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];
        static int[] par = new int[N];
        static long[] pot = new long[N], dist = new long[N];

        static void potInit(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0, n, 0);
            for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
                for(int u=0; u<n; u++) {
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.c != 0)
                            pot[e.v] = Math.min(pot[e.v], pot[u] + e.p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        static long minCostFlow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, 0, n, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0, n, INF);
            dist[s] = 0;

            if (sparse) {
                PriorityQueue<long[]> dk = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
                dk.offer(new long[]{0, s});
                while (!dk.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] uData = dk.poll();
                    int u = (int) uData[1];
                    if (vis[u]) continue;
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                            dk.offer(new long[]{-dist[e.v], e.v});
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                int u = s;
                while (u != -1) {
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                        }
                    }
                    u = -1;
                    long best = INF;
                    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
                        if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                            best = dist[i];
                            u = i;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[t] >= INF) {
                return 0;
            }
            long df = INF;
            for (int u = t; u != s; u = adj[(int) adj[u][par[u]].v].get(0).v) {
                Edge r = adj[(int) adj[u][par[u]].v].get(0);
                Edge e = adj[u].get(par[u]);
                df = Math.min(df, e.c - e.f);
            }
            for (int u = t; u != s; u = adj[(int) adj[u][par[u]].v].get(0).v) {
                Edge r = adj[(int) adj[u][par[u]].v].get(0);
                Edge e = adj[u].get(par[u]);
                e.f += df;
                adj[(int) r.v].get(r.r).f -= df;
                price[0] += df * e.p;
            }
            for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
                if (dist[i] != Long.MAX_VALUE)
                    pot[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + pot[i]);
            }
            return df;
        }

        static long minCostFlow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            // Optional initial pot update
            // potInit(n);
            long flow = 0, totalPrice = 0;
            long[] p = new long[]{0};
            long df;
            while ((df = mcf(s, t, p, n, sparse)) != 0) {
                flow += df;
                totalPrice += p[0];
            }
            price[0] = totalPrice;
            return flow;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());

        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n*T + 1;

        Flow.init(sink + 1);
        for (int i=0; i<k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            Flow.addEdge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t=0; t<T; t++) {
            Flow.addEdge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
                    Flow.addEdge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i=0; i<m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j=0; j<C; j++) {
                int cost = (j+1)*(j+1) - j*j;
                for (int t=1; t<T; t++) {
                    Flow.addEdge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n,1,cost*d + c);
                    Flow.addEdge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n,1,cost*d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = Flow.minCostFlow(source, sink, price, sink + 1, true);

        // Validate flow equals k
        if (flow != k) {
            System.err.println("Flow mismatch");
        }
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
